cases.name: pull-empty
cases.covers: Quiet replica: LIVE_START active, no COMMIT, LIVE_END with throughSeq advanced (§4.5)

cases.name: epoch-reset
cases.covers: Header-only reset after a partition log epoch change (§2.1)

cases.name: commits-incremental
cases.covers: A live section of two COMMIT frames, one spanning two tables; row codec exercising every column type incl. NULLs, bytes, non-BMP strings; scope map on changes

cases.name: bootstrap-segments
cases.covers: A catching-up unit section with an echo: SEGMENT_REF (sqlite, with signed URL) + SEGMENT_REF (rows, no URL) + SEGMENT_INLINE across two tables; incomplete bootstrapState in SUB_END; then an empty live section

cases.name: push-conflict
cases.covers: Rejected commit; conflict record with serverVersion, full-row serverRow, and the conflictColumns bitmap (§6.3)

cases.name: push-cached
cases.covers: Idempotent replay: status = cached, original results

cases.name: unit-revoked
cases.covers: SUB_START status revoked, reason sync.scope_revoked, no fenced record; an active unit whose echo carries one revoked and one active fenced record (§4.4)

cases.name: cursor-reset
cases.covers: A unit section with SUB_START status reset and LIVE_START status reset, both reason sync.cursor_expired (horizon signal), throughSeq = -1

cases.name: error-mid-stream
cases.covers: RESP_HEADER + SUB_START + ERROR + END: partially streamed failure (§1.4 abort rule)

cases.name: unknown-frame-skip
cases.covers: A reserved/unknown frame type inside the live section — MUST decode with the frame skipped (§9)

cases.name: commit-crdt-merge
cases.covers: A COMMIT upsert carrying a server-merged crdt column (§2.4 tag 8, §5.10.3): merged bytes ride the ordinary change payload, no CRDT-specific frame

cases.name: lease-issued
cases.covers: RESP_HEADER + LEASE (§7.3.2) + an empty live section: pins the 0x19 frame (leaseId, expiresAtMs) in its grammar position

cases.name: unregistered
cases.covers: LIVE_START status unregistered, LIVE_END with throughSeq = -1 and an empty echoDigest (§4.1)

cases.name: realtime-delta
cases.covers: A delta: LIVE_START, one COMMIT spanning three tables, LIVE_END with throughSeq = its commitSeq and an empty echoDigest (§8.2)

invalid.name: error-details-json-nul-key
invalid.covers: ERROR.details has an object key holding U+0000 (Conventions JSON validity rule)

invalid.name: sub-end-bootstrap-state-lone-surrogate
invalid.covers: SUB_END.bootstrapState is an unpaired low-surrogate escape (Conventions JSON validity rule)

invalid.name: fenced-out-of-order
invalid.covers: Fenced records out of ascending table order (§4.4)
